# absent, so this file is the exact list.

# S13/S13', proto/3gpp/ts29272/s13/s13.proto: no dictionary of its own, and
# nothing to list. Its six AVPs are S6a dictionary entries, and go-diameter
# has all of them (Terminal-Information, IMEI, Software-Version, 3GPP2-MEID
# and Equipment-Status in its S13 application, DRMP in its base protocol).

# SLh, proto/3gpp/ts29173/slh.proto. go-diameter has no SLh application;
# of its 13 own entries go-diameter knows 3GPP-AAA-Server-Name (SWx),
# Serving-Node, MME-Name, GMLC-Address and MME-Realm (Ro/Rf). Its other
# AVPs (MSISDN, SGSN-Number, GMLC-Number, Supported-Features and its
# members) are the S6a entries, imported, and go-diameter has all of them.
